title: Certify and publish V4 Guards 1.2.2
goal: Freeze the P04 repair on one exact commit, certify and reproducibly package two self-contained RIDs, publish an immutable 1.2.2 release, and independently verify fresh downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: The documentation-only release-prep PR passes all base-owned required checks and its final merge commit is the sole release source.
Full Guardrails and native Linux-complete and Windows-full Certification pass at that commit with the same source packageHash.
P04 proof, preflight and public-launcher regressions pass under unchanged independent host and Target checkpoints.
Two independent clean checkouts produce byte-identical linux-x64 and win-x64 archives with matching sidecars and the sole v4-guards-1.2.2 root.
Candidate/recovery certification passes before an annotated v4-guards-v1.2.2 tag and a non-draft, non-prerelease Release with exactly four assets are created.
Freshly downloaded Windows and Linux assets pass hash, install, public CLI, Companion and verified-uninstall checks; a records PR captures the evidence.
risks: Packaged documentation changes the source packageHash, so every certification and asset must use the final merged release commit.
A local success could hide drift or a mismatch in the published bytes unless fresh downloads and independent checkpoints are retained.
decisions: The 1.2.2 matrix contains only self-contained linux-x64 and win-x64 ZIPs and their SHA-256 sidecars.
The release-prep PR changes documentation only and carries no protected trust change.
P03 remains failed and release success does not imply IFX adoption or protection.
Exact publication evidence is added through a later records PR to avoid a circular source package hash.
validationCommands: v4-contract, v4-linux, v4-package, v4-windows and v4-required
full Guardrails and exact-commit V4 Certification
P04 application, preflight and installed public-launcher regressions with external safety checkpoints
two-clean-checkout RID reproducibility and candidate/recovery certification
fresh-download Windows and isolated Linux install/run/uninstall
